_about: Labelled probes for the retrieval measurement. Every query is written to share few or
no tokens with its target, so the keyword signal cannot carry it and the number says
something about semantic retrieval rather than about string matching.
Roughly half the set is Russian, matching the owner's corpus, which is 71% Cyrillic.
Decoys exist to make ranking mean something: with a handful of memories an unfloored
top-k returns the target for any query at all.
